add_definitions(-DBUILDING_DRMK)
spec2def(drmk.sys drmk.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# drmk.sys is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/drmk-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(drmk_shims OBJECT stubs.cpp)
target_link_libraries(drmk_shims PRIVATE libntoskrnl)
add_cargo_module(drmk drmk-cargo drmk.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    EXTRA_DEPENDS drmk_shims psdk)
